felder.hilfetext: Which app, installed on which device.
Where the recovery route is kept — never the code itself.

felder.feldname: Who may act if I cannot?
felder.hilfetext: Your own note — not a power of attorney and not a wallet function.

felder.feldname: What should apply in an emergency?
felder.hilfetext: A free-form note — no wallet keeps this.

felder.feldname: What arrangements exist, and where are they kept?
felder.hilfetext: For example your own note or a document — not something the wallet itself keeps.
